preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `clean_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Make the preserved authored map’s A→B→C mission continuously playable through ordinary input, then wrap it in a state-owned Fusepoint product shell and transparent tactical HUD that satisfy the active combat-AI and product-shell quality gates without replacing the accepted environment, roster, humanoids, or AK-74M viewmodel.

diagnosis.root_cause: Two integration seams block acceptance. First, navigation proves abstract point-to-point connectivity but does not bind deployment orientation, player guidance, objective placement, and route evidence to the actual navigation corners and player-capsule clearance; ordinary movement therefore follows the visible Alpha bearing into authored collision and never activates the encounter. Second, gameplay is still the application root: authoritative state is written directly into default-font opaque HUD cards, with no page-flow owner, focus/navigation model, persisted settings, opening-media presentation, or complete tactical HUD.

stop_conditions: Do not replace, duplicate, reposition, hide, delete, or extract authored Standoff environment child meshes; preserve its single instance, accepted wrapper datum, 30,379-triangle collision result, 505 navigation polygons, 544 navigation vertices, and clean 65-mesh validation result.

Do not change the preserved 18 enemy identities, 3/5/10 regional assignment, 2/3/7 route-pressure distribution, unique tactical slots, humanoid bindings, rifle sockets, or accepted AK-74M coupled hands/viewmodel unless a direct integration defect requires a local binding repair.

Stop and report a blocker if a player-capsule-clear route cannot be obtained from the authored streets by rebinding product-owned spawn/objective/route anchors; do not solve it with proxy floors, PlaneMesh roads, destructive source surgery, teleportation, autopilot, or mission-state injection.

Do not schedule or claim closure of the deferred bomb-finale issue. Result-page ownership and terminal-state handoff may be implemented, but explosion, death-video, third-person victory dance, and terminal cinematic completion remain outside this iteration.
Do not write run-owned evidence, issue-ledger records, reports/playtest output, or control-plane files. Formal recapture and issue closure belong to GameLoop Runtime and QA Tester.

Stop on any clean-boot regression, missing newly referenced resource, duplicated roster after restart, timer time grant on F6 restore, or loss of ordinary movement, mouse-look, fire, reload, or viewmodel behavior.

strategy.rationale: Repair the playability blocker with a materially different route strategy: use one live navigation-corner chain and capsule-clearance contract for spawn orientation, objective access, guidance, and evidence instead of further straight-line transform tuning. Once Alpha is ordinarily reachable, replace the gameplay-root/blockout-Label presentation with a native page-state owner and signal-bound tactical HUD, while retaining all accepted combat and world assets.

code: Parse every changed GDScript and Godot scene/resource; verify every new res:// URI exists, imports, and is instantiated in the shipped scene rather than merely present on disk.
Verify the InputMap has dedicated pause and required menu/gamepad navigation actions while physical F6 checkpoint restart remains distinct from physical R reload.

Inspect state ownership: MissionController remains authoritative for timer/objectives/checkpoints/terminal state; UI and media observe signals and cannot commit capture, keys, timer, damage, or results.

Verify page transitions, settings persistence, media completion/skip/fallback, pause ownership, and replay/home transitions are guarded against duplicate callbacks and input restoration occurs exactly once.
runtime: GameLoop Runtime/Tester: preserve clean_boot, then fresh-run one continuous ordinary-input route from deployment through Alpha, Bravo, and Charlie. Capture early/middle/late player position, route corner/progress, velocity, collision, timer, objective overlap/progress, checkpoint/key/route commits, and event IDs without state injection.

GameLoop Runtime/Tester: during the same mission trace, capture the preserved 3 Alpha, 5 Bravo, and 10 Charlie actors across autonomous locomotion/perception, search or flank/cover, aim/fire with real shot events, reload, hurt, and death; reject idle groups, first-frame fire, wall tracking, overlap, teleportation, doorway deadlock, or fabricated probe states.

GameLoop Runtime/Tester: fresh-launch with keyboard/mouse and separately with gamepad; navigate title, loadout, loading/briefing, gameplay, pause, settings, ordinary-death recovery, authoritative result handoff, replay, and return home while checking focus and input ownership.

GameLoop Runtime/Tester: capture opening presentation at deployment, approximately 6 seconds, 10 seconds, and 13 seconds; verify countdown and gameplay continue, text timing/style is correct, skip does not change mission causality, and failed media uses the matched still fallback with retry/home behavior where applicable.
visual: Compare fresh 1280×720 gameplay and page captures with the bound effect-imagination reference for hierarchy and composition, not branding or pixel copying.

At 1280×720 and 200% UI scale, inspect viewport corners and center for title, loading/briefing, pause/settings, gameplay HUD, and result pages; all critical fields must remain within the 5% safe area with no clipping or focus loss.

At spawn, Alpha approach, Alpha active/contested/secured, Bravo, and Charlie, verify minimap honesty, compass/camera agreement, objective identity, contextual progress visibility, health/weapon truth, and unobstructed reticle, enemy silhouettes, and viewmodel.

Reject default fonts, slash-slash narrative labels, broad opaque cards, card grids, deep-blue borders, baked dynamic text, debug legends, minimap/marker dishonesty, or any objective volume/beacon that becomes a near-plane curtain.

done_when: A fresh deployment binds to the preserved authored navigation map, faces or clearly exposes the first legal route corner, and ordinary walk/sprint/look input reaches the Alpha Area3D within the 30–45 second route budget without a persistent collision stall; Alpha overlap becomes true and authoritative capture progress rises above zero.

The same uninterrupted, non-injected run can proceed through Alpha, Bravo, and Charlie. Alpha and Bravo each commit one key, one checkpoint, and one route unlock exactly once; the timer never gains time, and Charlie becomes legal only after both keys.

Entering each region activates the preserved 3/5/10 enemy groups. Candidate state exposes enough live encounter data to distinguish perception/search, locomotion, cover or flank intent, aim telegraph, fire with a real shot event, reload, hurt, and death without fabricating those states in the probe.

Route evidence reports the actual ordered navigation corners, current/next corner, path length, player progress, capsule-clearance result, collision blocker information, objective overlap/progress, regional activation, and exactly-once mission event IDs. It does not rely on interpolated pseudo-waypoints, straight-line distance alone, state injection, teleportation, or autopilot.

The authored environment remains one intact runtime instance and the preserved collision, navigation, roster, viewmodel, ordinary movement, mouse-look, fire/reload, checkpoint, and clean-boot facts remain intact.
tasks.instructions: Replace the prior abstract-connectivity/straight-bearing approach with one authoritative route binding derived from the same live NavigationMap used by the preserved authored environment. Persist the ordered spawn→A, A→B, and B→C navigation corners; validate each segment against the player capsule and authored collision; orient deployment toward the first traversable decision and rebase only product-owned spawn/objective/route anchors when an endpoint or interaction volume is not capsule-accessible. Do not move authored map children. Expose the legal next corner and route state for later HUD consumption, but keep player locomotion fully manual. Make RouteProbe measure actual route progress and persistent collision stalls rather than synthesized lerp points. Keep MissionController authoritative and add bounded event/state fields needed to distinguish overlap, capture, checkpoint/key/route commits, active region, and real enemy transitions. Preserve the existing roster and AI implementation unless live ordinary entry reveals a direct binding defect.

Starting a mission commits loadout, shows loading/briefing, and enters deployment exactly once. The opening presentation has matched military-base media or a coherent still fallback; story text types during 0–6 seconds, holds through 10 seconds, fades by 13 seconds, remains borderless with deliberate non-default typography and ivory text plus amber/yellow outline or glow, and does not block the 5.

After deployment, movement, aiming, firing, the reticle, and the authoritative countdown remain active beneath the opening overlay. Skip affects presentation only; pause, restart, terminal state, missing media, and playback failure produce deterministic interruption/fallback behavior without advancing mission truth.

The normal 1280×720 gameplay frame contains a transparent tactical hierarchy: north-up live minimap with player heading, real route openings and A/B/C state; live compass; countdown rail with distinct A/B capture and C bomb identities plus two keys; contextual objective/progress band; authoritative health/stance/damage state; weapon/mode/ammo/action state; reticle states; and a bounded combat or .
tasks.instructions:
Create a native state-owned application shell instead of layering dialogs over live gameplay. It must own boot/title, loadout, loading/briefing, deployment transition, pause/settings, ordinary-death recovery, result, replay, and home navigation; enable gameplay input and simulation only in legal states; expose comprehensible retry/home and still fallbacks for missing resources; and persist the required accessibility/settings values. Bind result pages only to authoritative terminal state plus a presentation-complete handoff, without implementing the deferred bomb finale. Replace the current opaque TopPanel/WeaponPanel and default-font slash labels with a coherent transparent tactical HUD that observes MissionController, player, weapon, route, camera, and enemy knowledge state rather than owning truth. Objective detail must be contextual outside interaction proximity, and diagnostic/control legends must remain hidden by default. Opening story/media must remain non-blocking after deployment and follow the PRD timing.
